readings.gospelAcclamationText:
R. Alleluia, alleluia.
The heaven's were opened and the Father's voice was heard:
this is my Son, the beloved; listen to him!
R. Alleluia, alleluia.

or Cf. John 1:29

R. Alleluia, alleluia.
John saw Jesus approaching him, and said:
Behold the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world.
R. Alleluia, alleluia.
